### 📓 Docs Drift Check
This PR changes **5** package(s): `@objectstack/cloud-connection`, `@objectstack/core`, `@objectstack/mcp`, `@objectstack/plugin-sharing`, `@objectstack/service-storage`, touching **19** documentable anchor(s).

**1** hand-written doc(s) NAME something this change touched and may need an implementation-accuracy re-verification:

- `content/docs/kernel/contracts/auth-service.mdx`  _(via isAuthGateActive (symbol, a method of type GateAuthService))_

<details><summary>What this run could not see</summary>

- **1** name(s) were too generic to anchor anything (single lowercase words)
- the SDK route bridge reached **54** of **206** client-bound route-ledger rows — the other **152** have no registrar `path:` tail to select them, so pages documenting THEIR client methods cannot appear above, on this or any run. Of those **152**: **0** are remediable by widening that discovery convention (an in-repo file declares the path; the convention did not scan it); **55** are structural — on a ledger where NOT ONE row is declared in-repo, so no discovery change reaches them at any price; **97** are undecided (no in-repo declaration, on a ledger that has other in-repo registrars — absence and an unreadable spelling are not distinguishable here). The rows themselves: `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --bridge-coverage`
- a page that states a rule by its **inputs** shares no identifier with the **emitter** that implements the rule, so an emitter-only diff cannot list it — not on this run and not on any run. Measured on #11430: `content/docs/protocol/objectql/types.mdx` documents the text-family column mapping by the ObjectQL type names it maps FROM (`text` / `textarea` / `html`) while the diff changed `createColumn`; it went unlisted, and it was the page that diff falsified, in four places. No shared token exists to detect this on, so a rule your change carries has to be re-read by hand in the pages that restate it.
- a key NAME is not a key, so the hand re-read the line above prescribes can land on the wrong schema. The same spelling is authorable on one governed type and a `[REMOVED]` tombstone on another for each of `active`, `aria`, `joins`, `objects`, `template`, `tools` and `version` (censused on #19093 over the liveness ledger's governed types, top-level keys); nothing in a search result distinguishes the two, so a grep hit on a LIVE example reads as evidence about the DEAD key. Measured on #19059: `content/docs/ai/agents.mdx` was reported as contradicting the `agent.tools` tombstone over its `tools:` example at `:161`, which is inside the `defineSkill({` block opened at `:155` — the page was already correct. Settle ownership by PARSING the value against both schemas, never by the name: that literal PASSES `SkillSchema`, and as an `AgentSchema` it FAILS at `tools` with the tombstone prescription. ⛔ These names are not the whole class — a key retired through a `.strict()` guidance map leaves no tombstone in the walked shape and none of them here (`tool.category`, live as `AIToolDefinition.category`).

Coarse fallback — **42** page(s) merely *mention* a changed package (the pre-#9192 predicate, kept for the deliberately-wide backstop): `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json f9b421716dd79df6c7c3a34bbd5a3a9f425e84f4` → `packageMentionDocs`.
</details>

<details><summary>Which tree this was computed on</summary>

This run read `content/docs` from `e70398ac366d29035d5fb806996075faa603805b` — the merge of head `fc4aff4a17a782a70e82cecb27e8effe36e2a144` into base `f9b421716dd79df6c7c3a34bbd5a3a9f425e84f4`, which is what `actions/checkout` gives a `pull_request` run. **Not** the PR head.

A worktree cut from an older `main` holds a different `content/docs`, so re-deriving there can legitimately return a different list — that is a **different tree, not a wrong row**. To answer on the same tree:

```sh
# while this PR is open — GitHub drops the merge commit once it closes
git fetch origin e70398ac366d29035d5fb806996075faa603805b && git checkout e70398ac366d29035d5fb806996075faa603805b
# afterwards, rebuild it from the two parents, which stay fetchable
git fetch origin f9b421716dd79df6c7c3a34bbd5a3a9f425e84f4 fc4aff4a17a782a70e82cecb27e8effe36e2a144 && git checkout -B drift-repro f9b421716dd79df6c7c3a34bbd5a3a9f425e84f4 && git merge --no-ff fc4aff4a17a782a70e82cecb27e8effe36e2a144

node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json f9b421716dd79df6c7c3a34bbd5a3a9f425e84f4
```

⚠️ That checkout carried **uncommitted changes**, so the commit above does not fully identify what was read.
</details>

> Advisory only, and a **precision-first** one (#9192): a page is listed because it names a
> symbol, wire route or SDK method this diff touched — not because it mentions a changed
> package. Each row says which anchor put it there, so a wrong row is reportable rather than
> merely annoying. To re-verify, run the `docs-accuracy-audit` workflow scoped to these files:
> `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs f9b421716dd79df6c7c3a34bbd5a3a9f425e84f4` → pass the list as
> `args.docs`, on the commit named under **Which tree this was computed on**.

## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `fc4aff4a17a782a70e82cecb27e8effe36e2a144`
Local-runs: none

### ① Derived judgments

Inputs: cards #23455 and #23456 (bodies, the family scope `6167950628`, both claims, the dev report `6171624798`), ruling C′ `6159450584` items 1, 3 and 4 and letter A `6165848580` on #23287, PR #23508's body, file list and net diff against the merge base `394f65e891`, and the head's check-runs, read last. The seat's own `Collected ·` comment was not an input. Code read on the head fetched into a private ref at this sha; nothing built, run or re-run.

1. **Install-local resolver (`@objectstack/cloud-connection`, member 1): right.** `resolveInstallPrincipal` hands `resolveAuthzContext` `userAuthGates: userAuthGateSourceOf(authService)` (`ctx.getService('auth')` read per request, the sibling seams' shape) and refuses on `evaluateAuthGate(authz, '')`. The session path's answer is unchanged: `normalizeAuthGate` reads `.authGate` off whatever it is handed, and the shared resolver sets `authGate = normalizeAuthGate(sessionData.user)` on its session path, so the gate reads the same field off the same session user the resolver used to capture as `sessionUser`; `if (!authz.userId) return null` still precedes the consult and `refuseHeldSession` is unchanged. Key path: `resolveApiKeyAdmission` asks the source after the org-less refusal, `accountScopeAuthGate` picks the first `account`-scope posture, `held` carries the same `principal` as `admitted` plus `gate`, and the resolver lifts `gate` to `authz.authGate`. `MFA_REQUIRED` is `account` scope; `PASSWORD_EXPIRED` and `PASSWORD_RESET_REQUIRED` are `credential` (`AUTH_GATE_SCOPES`), so a credential-scope posture carries no gate and is served. Pinned over the booted plugin's five doors: `403` with `{ success: false, error: { code: 'MFA_REQUIRED', message } }`, zero effects, ledger untouched; served on `PASSWORD_RESET_REQUIRED`; served again once the posture clears with the key row unchanged. Items 1 and 4 met on this seam.

2. **MCP stdio (`@objectstack/mcp`, member 2, #23456): right.** `resolveStdioExecutionContext` takes a required `userAuthGates`, read per call by `resolveStdioUserAuthGates(ctx)` beside `resolveStdioTenancyPosture`, and assembles `authGate: authz.authGate`. `resolvePrincipal` asks `evaluateAuthGate(ec, '')` and throws `stdioAuthGateRefusal(gate)` (`code` the posture's, `status` 403, `message` the session's) before it returns a context. Every principal-bound path goes through it: the six bridge verbs in `stdio-data-bridge.ts` (`query`, `get`, `create`, `update`, `remove`, `aggregate`) each `await resolvePrincipal()` as their first statement, before `enforceApiExposure` and any engine call, and the record resource's `getRecord` in `plugin.ts` does the same before its exposure gate and `find`. `listObjects`, `describeObject`, prompts and resource listings resolve no principal, as before (the ADR-0101 boundary). After the start probe `initial` feeds only the warning, the info line and the localization hoist's `tenantId`/`userId` (a settings read, not a principal-bound row read). Start-with-a-warning is the right reading of item 4: the key is valid and nothing is written, so a start refusal would outlast the owner's remediation until a restart, while the per-call ask (the ADR-0101 D1 schedule revocation already rides) lets a posture that appears refuse the next call and one that clears serve the next; `warn` is the right level for a visible functional hold. Pinned on a real `ObjectKernel` with core unmocked: start succeeds with exactly one warning naming `MFA_REQUIRED`; `query`, `get`, `create` and the resource reject `{ code: 'MFA_REQUIRED', status: 403, message }` with nothing written; a real `StdioServerTransport` `tools/call` answers `isError` with the remediation message; credential-scope served; appear-then-clear on one live session with the key row unchanged.

3. **The required inputs: right, and the census is complete.** `ResolveAuthzInput.userAuthGates: UserAuthGateSource | undefined`, and `tenancyPosture` and `userAuthGates` on `resolveApiKeyAdmission` and `resolveApiKeyPrincipal`, are required (`tenancyPosture` because a required parameter cannot follow an optional one; `ResolveAuthzInput.tenancyPosture` stays optional). Production `resolveAuthzContext` callers on the head, `git grep` over the whole tree minus tests, test kits and `test/` directories: `rest-server.ts:3206`, `runtime/security/resolve-execution-context.ts:244`, `sharing-plugin.ts:965`, `service-datasource/admin-routes.ts:501`, `settings-service-plugin.ts:324` (untouched, each already `userAuthGateSourceOf(authService)` from PR #23440); `cloud-connection:3363` and `mcp/plugin.ts:231` (new, real source); `storage-service-plugin.ts:1403` (new, `userAuthGateSourceOf(resolveGateAuthService(registry))`). `resolveApiKeyAdmission` callers: `resolve-authz-context.ts:454` and `api-key.ts:286` (pass-throughs), `storage-service-plugin.ts:1230` (`userAuthGateSourceOf(auth)`, untouched). No caller in `examples/`, `apps/`, `scripts/`, `qa/`, or any `.mts`/`.tsx`/`.js`/`.mjs`, on `origin/main` or on the head; the caller set is the same eight sites plus the definition on both. No production site passes a bare `undefined`. The diff removes exactly two `userAuthGates` lines, the two `?:` declarations, and adds 142 `userAuthGates: undefined` in tests and the sharing testkit plus the positional `undefined`s; the three test files whose call count exceeds their key count name the call in a docblock only, and the two others name it inside a string literal. `exec-context-seam.testkit.ts` composes no auth service and is neither on plugin-sharing's `index.ts` nor in its published `dist`; `armed.ts` names the stack's real `auth` service. The four `@ts-expect-error` pins sit in a never-invoked function compiled by `check:test-typecheck`, where an unused directive is TS2578.

4. **`resolveApiKeyPrincipal`: fail-closed, right as the interim.** `admission.outcome === 'admitted' ? principal : undefined`, so `held` collapses to no principal exactly as `refused` and `none` do. It stays exported by core `security/index.ts` and re-exported by runtime (`security/api-key.ts`, `security/index.ts`, and `export * from '@objectstack/core'`). The collapse cannot carry the posture's code; its docblock says so and points a request-answering host at `resolveApiKeyAdmission`. Pinned held / credential / clears.

5. **Storage `:1383` authorizer: the pass-through claim is true.** `registerStorageFamily` mounts all eleven routes (`storage-routes.ts` `:880` to `:1563`) through `mountFamilyRoute`, which runs `refuseHeldSession(readGatedSessionUser, …)` before the handler; `buildAuthGateSessionReader`'s reader asks `resolveApiKeyAdmission` with `userAuthGateSourceOf(auth)` and the door's tenancy posture and answers `{ authGate }` on `held`, which `evaluateAuthGate` turns into the `403`. `composeStorageRoutes` binds that reader and the download authorizer from the same `auth` service through `resolveGateAuthService`, and both mounts (`start()` and `mount-storage-routes.ts`) go through it. `buildFileReadAuthorizer` never reads `authGate`, so with the source a held key resolves to the same `userId`, `tenantId` and grants as before and is judged on ownership as before. When no gate feature is active the reader returns before asking and plugin-auth's `resolveUserAuthGates` answers `[]` with no read, so no `held` can arise at the authorizer either; it fails open to `[]` on a lookup error. Nothing changes on the wire.

Public surface otherwise: no route, header, status or body moves beyond the two narrowings; no governed path in the file list (`.claude/**`, `docs/adr/**`, `skills/**`, `AGENTS.md`, `CLAUDE.md`, `.github/workflows/**` all absent); 38 files, 1226 changed lines.

### ② Semver level

- The changeset `.changeset/23455-key-admission-posture-required.md`: `@objectstack/core`, `runtime`, `cloud-connection` and `mcp` `minor`; `service-storage` `patch`. Right. Two doors narrow their accept-set and core's three entries take required inputs, a BREAKING narrowing shipped `minor` under the launch-window convention; `runtime` re-exports `resolveApiKeyPrincipal` explicitly and the rest through `export *`, so its importers see the same narrowing; `service-storage` has no wire change (① 5). No other published package carries a non-test source change.
- The ADR-0087 marker `not-required (runtime-interface-only packages/core/src/security/resolve-authz-context.ts#ResolveAuthzInput …)`: right. The operand is an exported `interface` at the head, not a `*.zod.ts`, not under `spec/src/contracts/`, not a Zod projection, and `git grep` finds no `.zod.ts`, contracts or `.object.ts` file naming it in code. The two function signatures that narrow with it are named in the marker's prose and are runtime functions, not metadata surfaces.
- `Clause-②: no (narrowing)` in the changeset is the arm `check:adr-0087-registration` reads, and the marker discharges it. The PR body carries a bare `Clause-②: no`, the claim's line verbatim: the value is right (no accept-set widens) and `judgeLevel` reaches `clean` on it beside the `minor` grades; it drops the `(narrowing)` arm the changeset and the `!` title assert, and no gate cross-checks the two. See ③ 8.
- The remedy as a prose line: the dev's claim holds. `no-migration-prescription` refuses a detectable prescription; `runtime-interface-only` inherits that refusal as a narrowing of it, by the gate's own header; `type-surface-only` needs an erased base type and `runtime-export-retired` a retired export, neither of which this diff has; `registered` would name a metadata conversion for a change `objectstack migrate meta` cannot reach. Nothing an author can write is removed or renamed, and the one-line fix is stated: `userAuthGates: userAuthGateSourceOf(authService)` wherever `auth` is reachable, `undefined` on a kernel without `plugin-auth`, `tenancyPosture` explicit on the two positional functions. `Check Changeset` and `Lint & Repo Gates` are `success` on this head.

### ③ Boundary flags

The dev's deviations, each answered:
1. Member 3 not retired: Q1 below.
2. The prose remedy: checked true in ②.
3. The stdio code flattened on the wire: Q2 below.
4. `runtime` `minor` and `service-storage` `patch`: checked right in ②.
5. `tenancyPosture` required positionally while `ResolveAuthzInput.tenancyPosture` stays optional: right for this card, whose contract is the owner-posture source. Residual, not this PR's: an omitted `tenancyPosture` on the interface still compiles and silently disables the two tenancy refusals, the same by-omission class this PR closes for `userAuthGates`; every production caller passes it today. Escalated to the seat as a candidate card; no carrier here.
6. Test-layer reach (141 literals, 20 positional calls, `armed.ts` on the real source): verified in ① 3; no test subject changed.
7. `origin/main` `394f65e891` merged before the PR: it is the merge base, and the caller census on main and head is identical.
8. PR body `Clause-②: no` beside the changeset's `no (narrowing)`: each gate reads a consistent input for its own purpose; the body line under-declares the direction. Escalated to the seat: carry `no (narrowing)` on the body when the seat record is posted, or keep the claim's verbatim line; not blocking.
9. Model-free trailers: nothing in the diff or the changeset names a model.

Q1, retire `resolveApiKeyPrincipal`: **B stands for this head; A is escalated.** The function is fail-closed on `held` (① 4), has zero non-test callers here on main and head and none in the dev's objectui reading, and `objectstack-ai/cloud` is unreadable from this fleet and from this review. The ruling's retirement premise has an unmeasured third leg, so retirement waits on a reading by someone who can read cloud (a follow-up under `runtime-export-retired` with runtime's explicit re-exports). Nothing is open meanwhile: the function cannot admit a held owner's key.

Q2, the stdio code on the wire: **this PR is correct without it.** The seam refuses with the posture's `code`, `status` 403 and the session's `message` in the thrown envelope, which is item 1's "same code" at the seam and item 4's remediation pointer. The data tools' `errorResult(messageOf(err))` catches and the record resource's `{ error: message }` flatten every coded refusal on both MCP faces, `RECORD_NOT_FOUND` included, and #15942 chose `errorResultFromThrown` for the action tools only; the HTTP MCP face is refused `403 MFA_REQUIRED` by the dispatcher before the server sees it. A shared-layer widening beyond this family, filed by the seat as #23509.

Out-of-scope findings: (a) the flattening above, filed; (b) ADR-0101 (Tier H) and `qa/dogfood/test/authz-conformance.matrix.ts` still name `resolveApiKeyPrincipal` in the stdio chain, prose only, no carrier; the matrix row can ride the Tier H ADR-0101 correction or the Q1 follow-up; (c) principal-free stdio calls reach a held key exactly as a revoked key does, the pre-existing ADR-0101 boundary, no carrier.

Check-runs on this head, read at 2026-10-14T15:36Z: 40 runs, 33 `success`, 6 `skipped` (Build Docs, Console Pin Gate, the dogfood shard matrix and Verify CLI, the opt-in packed-tarball smoke, Temporal Conformance: full-battery or opt-in jobs), 0 `failure`, 1 `in_progress`: `Test Core (4/6)`, started 15:11:27Z with its five siblings, which concluded `success` between 15:30Z and 15:34Z. Of the five required contexts, `Lint & Repo Gates`, `TypeScript Type Check`, `Build Core` and `Governed Surface Queue Guard` are `success`; `Test Core` is not yet green. `in_progress` is not a pass: the owning seat arms nothing until that shard concludes `success`.

## 席位核对

`domain:spec` seat 4 (#18917) · `sunhaolin` · session `session_0121ooBYRmS8ziFXm9ai5YHm` · claims `6168614481` (#23455) and `6168634754` (#23456) · reviewed head `fc4aff4a17a782a70e82cecb27e8effe36e2a144` · 2026-10-14T15:41Z

**Verdict: ACCEPT.** Not governed (`check-governed-merges --pr 23508`), 38 files, +1055 / −171 (1226 lines, under the 3000 threshold). The `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER` review on this head is PASS (`6172195145`).

1. **Shape.** Draft, `Fixes #23455` and `Fixes #23456` on their own lines, `Clause-②: no` at line start (the claim's closed spelling). The changeset carries `Clause-②: no (narrowing)`: `@objectstack/core`, `runtime`, `cloud-connection` and `mcp` are `minor` (BREAKING), `service-storage` is `patch`. Its ADR-0087 marker is `runtime-interface-only` on `ResolveAuthzInput`, verified by the gate.
2. **Premises against the dispatch.**
   - Family members 1 and 2 were wired on a real source. Member 3, `resolveApiKeyPrincipal`, is not retired: the ruling's premise has an unmeasured leg (`objectstack-ai/cloud` is unreadable from this fleet). The prohibition branch was taken instead: a required source, with `held` collapsed to no principal. That is fail-closed; retirement waits on a cloud reading.
   - The class fix's premise held: every production caller names its source with no new plumbing. The review's census found eight call sites, identical on `main` and head, with no bare `undefined` in production.
   - MCP stdio asks the posture on every principal-bound call (six bridge verbs plus the record resource) and starts with one warning, per ruling C′ item 4.
   - The storage `:1383` authorizer's pass-through claim is true: all eleven routes mount through `mountFamilyRoute`.
3. **Gates and evidence.**
   - Head check-runs read at this record: 35 success, 6 skipped (full-battery or opt-in jobs), 0 failures, 0 in progress. `mergeable_state` is `clean`.
   - The dev's local reconciliation was 76 derived, 76 run, 0 not measured.
   - Ablations: install-local and stdio went 2F/1P each; two compile pins went red through TS2578 when the input was made optional.
4. **Accepted deviations.**
   - Member 3 kept, as above.
   - The remedy is written as a prose line, not a FROM → TO block. The gate refuses a detectable prescription under every honest disposition; the review checked that claim against the gate's header.
   - `tenancyPosture` became positional-required beside `userAuthGates`.
   - `runtime` is graded `minor` for its re-exports.
   - 141 test literals carry an explicit `userAuthGates: undefined`, and `armed.ts` names the real source.
5. **Out-of-scope dispositions.**
   - Data tools and the record resource flattening a coded refusal to its message (both MCP faces): filed as #23509.
   - ADR-0101 and the dogfood authz matrix still name `resolveApiKeyPrincipal` in the stdio chain. These are prose, in Acceptance notes, `carrier:` none; they ride the member-3 follow-up once cloud is read.
   - Principal-free stdio calls reach a held key as they reach a revoked one. This is the pre-existing ADR-0101 boundary, `carrier:` none.
   - The review's residual: `ResolveAuthzInput.tenancyPosture` stays optional, the same by-omission class. Every production caller passes it today, so there is no reach; dropped from filing.
6. **Landing clauses.**
   - (a) The `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER` PASS on the landing head: met, `6172195145`.
   - (b) Every check green or skipped by design: met at this reading.
   - (c) `mergeable_state` clean at enqueue: met at this reading.
